svg.title: What has been measured, and what has not
svg.desc: On the plates task, release-anchored review raised balanced accuracy from 0.81 to 0.94 and cut failures judged as success from 38.5% to 12.8%; on the screws task it reached 0.76 with 49% of failures judged successes; time-segment labelling is at parity with a direct call; whether curated data improves a policy is not established.

svg.text: Whether training on LEVI-curated data improves a robot policy. Training manifests are delivered; training and robot evaluation are the user's team's next step.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Automatic live verdicts are unreviewed and over-call success on tasks that place several objects.

svg.text: Plates: 60-episode blind test. Project's own numbers; docs/VALIDATION.md records the 0.94 / 12.8% re-run.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Some screws outcomes were seen by the coordinator through annotator replies; they were not used for tuning.
